SELECT su.login_name AS sid, COALESCE(su.name_en, su.name_ch) AS name, COALESCE(cm.major, cm.major) AS major, COALESCE(cm.grade, cm.grade) AS grade, (case when su.international_student = 1 then 'Y' when su.international_student = 0 then 'N' else '' end ) AS internationalStudent, ( select STRING_AGG(DISTINCT concat(t3.category_name,'_',t2.course_code), E'
') from biz_course_master t1 left join biz_course_detail t2 on t1.id = t2.course_master_id and t1.remove_flag = 0 left join biz_course_category t3 on t3.category_code = t2.course_category_code and t3.remove_flag = 0 and t3.major = t1.major and t3.grade = t1.grade where 1=1 and t1.id = cm.id and t2.course_category_code = 'Civic Education Course' and t2.progress = 1 ) as progress1, ( select STRING_AGG(DISTINCT concat(t3.category_name,'_',t2.course_code), E'
') from biz_course_master t1 left join biz_course_detail t2 on t1.id = t2.course_master_id and t1.remove_flag = 0 left join biz_course_category t3 on t3.category_code = t2.course_category_code and t3.remove_flag = 0 and t3.major = t1.major and t3.grade = t1.grade where 1=1 and t1.id = cm.id and t2.course_category_code = 'Civic Education Course' and t2.progress = 2 ) as progress2, ( select STRING_AGG(DISTINCT concat(t3.category_name,'_',t2.course_code), E'
') from biz_course_master t1 left join biz_course_detail t2 on t1.id = t2.course_master_id and t1.remove_flag = 0 left join biz_course_category t3 on t3.category_code = t2.course_category_code and t3.remove_flag = 0 and t3.major = t1.major and t3.grade = t1.grade where 1=1 and t1.id = cm.id and t2.course_category_code = 'Civic Education Course' and t2.progress = 3 ) as progress3, 0 AS totalUnitsPassed, ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(cd.units, 0)),0) FROM biz_course_detail cd WHERE cd.course_master_id = cm.id AND cd.course_category_code = 'University Core' AND cd.self_check in('1') ) AS ucPass, ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(cd.units, 0)),0) FROM biz_course_detail cd WHERE cd.course_master_id = cm.id AND cd.course_category_code = 'University Core' AND cd.self_check in('2') ) AS ucNr, ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(cd.units, 0)),0) FROM biz_course_detail cd WHERE cd.course_master_id = cm.id AND cd .course_category_code = 'University Core' AND cd.self_check in('3') ) AS ucIp, ( select COALESCE(t3.units,0) from biz_course_detail t1 left join biz_course_template t2 on t1.course_template_id = t2.id left join biz_course_category t3 on t2.course_category_id = t3.id where t1.course_master_id = cm.id and t1.course_category_code = 'University Core' limit 1 ) AS ucLeft, ( select COALESCE(STRING_AGG(course_code, E'
' ORDER BY course_code asc),'') from biz_course_detail where course_master_id = cm.id and course_category_code = 'University Core' and self_check = '0' and remove_flag = 0 ) AS ucRemark, ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(cd.units, 0)),0) FROM biz_course_detail cd WHERE cd.course_master_id = cm.id AND cd.course_category_code = 'School Package' AND cd.self_check in('1') ) AS spPass, ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(cd.units, 0)),0) FROM biz_course_detail cd WHERE cd.course_master_id = cm.id AND cd.course_category_code = 'School Package' AND cd.self_check in('2') ) AS spNr, ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(cd.units, 0)),0) FROM biz_course_detail cd WHERE cd.course_master_id = cm.id AND cd .course_category_code = 'School Package' AND cd.self_check in('3') ) AS spIp, ( select COALESCE(t3.units,0) from biz_course_detail t1 left join biz_course_template t2 on t1.course_template_id = t2.id left join biz_course_category t3 on t2.course_category_id = t3.id where t1.course_master_id = cm.id and t1.course_category_code = 'School Package' limit 1 ) AS spLeft, ( select COALESCE(STRING_AGG(course_code, E'
' ORDER BY course_code asc),'') from biz_course_detail where course_master_id = cm.id and course_category_code = 'School Package' and self_check = '0' and remove_flag = 0 ) AS spRemark, ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(cd.units, 0)),0) FROM biz_course_detail cd WHERE cd.course_master_id = cm.id AND cd.course_category_code = 'Major Required Courses' AND cd.self_check in('1') ) AS mrPass, ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(cd.units, 0)),0) FROM biz_course_detail cd WHERE cd.course_master_id = cm.id AND cd.course_category_code = 'Major Required Courses' AND cd.self_check in('2') ) AS mrNr, ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(cd.units, 0)),0) FROM biz_course_detail cd WHERE cd.course_master_id = cm.id AND cd .course_category_code = 'Major Required Courses' AND cd.self_check in('3') ) AS mrIp, ( select COALESCE(t3.units,0) from biz_course_detail t1 left join biz_course_template t2 on t1.course_template_id = t2.id left join biz_course_category t3 on t2.course_category_id = t3.id where t1.course_master_id = cm.id and t1.course_category_code = 'Major Required Courses' limit 1 ) AS mrLeft, ( select COALESCE(STRING_AGG(course_code, E'
' ORDER BY course_code asc),'') from biz_course_detail where course_master_id = cm.id and course_category_code = 'Major Required Courses' and self_check = '0' and remove_flag = 0 ) AS mrRemark, ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(cd.units, 0)),0) FROM biz_course_detail cd WHERE cd.course_master_id = cm.id AND cd.course_category_code = 'Major Elective Courses' AND cd.self_check in('1') AND UPPER(TRIM(cd.part)) = 'A' ) AS meaPass, ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(cd.units, 0)),0) FROM biz_course_detail cd WHERE cd.course_master_id = cm.id AND cd.course_category_code = 'Major Elective Courses' AND cd.self_check in('2') AND UPPER(TRIM(cd.part)) = 'A' ) AS meaNr, ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(cd.units, 0)),0) FROM biz_course_detail cd WHERE cd.course_master_id = cm.id AND cd .course_category_code = 'Major Elective Courses' AND cd.self_check in('3') AND UPPER(TRIM(cd.part)) = 'A' ) AS meaIp, ( select COALESCE(t3.units,0) from biz_course_detail t1 left join biz_course_template t2 on t1.course_template_id = t2.id left join biz_course_category t3 on t2.course_category_id = t3.id where t1.course_master_id = cm.id and t1.course_category_code = 'Major SELECT COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(cd.units, 0)),0) FROM biz_course_detail cd WHERE cd.course_master_id = cm.id AND cd .course_category_code = 'Major Elective Courses' AND cd.self_check in('1') AND UPPER(TRIM(cd.part)) = 'B' ) AS mebPass, ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(cd.units, 0)),0) FROM biz_course_detail cd WHERE cd.course_master_id = cm.id AND cd .course_category_code = 'Major Elective Courses' AND cd.self_check in('2') AND UPPER(TRIM(cd.part)) = 'B' ) AS mebNr, ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(cd.units, 0)),0) FROM biz_course_detail cd WHERE cd.course_master_id = cm.id AND cd .course_category_code = 'Major Elective Courses' AND cd.self_check in('3') AND UPPER(TRIM(cd.part)) = 'B' ) AS mebIp, ( select COALESCE(t3.units,0) from biz_course_detail t1 left join biz_course_template t2 on t1.course_template_id = t2.id left join biz_course_category t3 on t2.course_category_id = t3.id where t1.course_master_id = cm.id and t1.course_category_code = 'Major Elective Courses' AND UPPER(TRIM(t3.part)) = 'B' limit 1 ) AS mebLeft, ( select t3.title from biz_course_detail t1 left join biz_course_template t2 on t1.course_template_id = t2.id left join biz_course_category t3 on t2.course_category_id = t3.id where t1.course_master_id = cm.id and t1.course_category_code = 'Major Elective Courses' AND UPPER(TRIM(t3.part)) = 'B' limit 1 ) AS mebUnits, ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(cd.units, 0)),0) FROM biz_course_detail cd WHERE cd.course_master_id = cm.id AND cd .course_category_code = 'Free Elective' AND cd.self_check in('1') ) AS fePass, ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(cd.units, 0)),0) FROM biz_course_detail cd WHERE cd.course_master_id = cm.id AND cd .course_category_code = 'Free Elective' AND cd.self_check in('2') ) AS feNr, ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(cd.units, 0)),0) FROM biz_course_detail cd WHERE cd.course_master_id = cm.id AND cd .course_category_code = 'Free Elective' AND cd.self_check in('3') ) AS feIp, ( select COALESCE(units,0) from biz_course_category where major in ( select DISTINCT t2.major from biz_course_detail t1 left join biz_course_master t2 on t1.course_master_id = t2.id where t2.id = cm.id and t1.course_category_code = 'Free Elective' ) and category_code = 'Free Elective' limit 1 ) AS feLeft, cm.reason AS remarks FROM biz_course_master cm LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON su.id = cm.student_id WHERE cm.remove_flag = 0 AND cm.status IN(1, 3)

select t2.grade ,t1.major ,COALESCE((select sum(1) from biz_course_master where remove_flag = 0 and major = t1.major),0) as total ,COALESCE((select sum(1) from biz_course_master where remove_flag = 0 and major = t1.major and status = 1),0) as submit_total ,COALESCE((select sum(1) from biz_course_master where remove_flag = 0 and major = t1.major and status = 0),0) as unfilled_total ,COALESCE((select sum(1) from biz_course_master where remove_flag = 0 and major = t1.major and status = 1 and student_check_box = 1),0) as self_declaration_total ,COALESCE((select sum(1) from biz_course_master where remove_flag = 0 and major = t1.major and status = 3),0) as officer_checked_total from biz_course_master t1 left join sys_user t2 on t1.student_id = t2.id where 1=1 and t1.remove_flag = 0 and t2.remove_flag = 0 group by t2.grade,t1.major

select t2.grade ,t1.major ,COALESCE((select sum(1) from biz_course_master where remove_flag = 0 and major = t1.major),0) as total ,COALESCE((select sum(1) from biz_course_master where remove_flag = 0 and major = t1.major and status = 1),0) as submit_total ,COALESCE((select sum(1) from biz_course_master where remove_flag = 0 and major = t1.major and status = 0),0) as unfilled_total ,COALESCE((select sum(1) from biz_course_master where remove_flag = 0 and major = t1.major and status = 1 and student_check_box = 1),0) as self_declaration_total ,COALESCE((select sum(1) from biz_course_master where remove_flag = 0 and major = t1.major and status = 3),0) as officer_checked_total from biz_course_master t1 left join sys_user t2 on t1.student_id = t2.id where 1=1 and t1.remove_flag = 0 and t2.remove_flag = 0 group by t2.grade,t1.major
